DIAGNOSIS READY: Drug-induced hypersensitivity syndrome (DRESS) secondary to new arthritis medication.

This constellation of symptoms—sudden onset fever-like illness, new cough, mucositis, and a widespread rash appearing days after starting a new drug for arthritis—is highly characteristic of DRESS. Given the severity and systemic nature of these findings, immediate discontinuation of the suspected medication and hospital admission for supportive care and potential steroid treatment are required.
